# DaFont

> DaFont is a comprehensive free font repository offering thousands of downloadable typefaces across multiple languages and styles.

DaFont serves as a community-driven font library where designers and users can discover, download, and share typefaces for personal and creative projects. The platform supports multiple languages including English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, and Portuguese, making it accessible to a global audience.

## Core Browsing

- [DaFont - Download fonts](https://www.dafont.com): DaFont homepage: browse freely downloadable fonts by style, author, or popularity
- [New fonts](https://www.dafont.com/new.php): Browse newly added fonts on DaFont by recent upload date
- [Top fonts](https://www.dafont.com/top.php): Most downloaded and popular fonts on DaFont ranked by popularity
- [Authors Directory](https://www.dafont.com/authors.php): DaFont font authors directory: browse designers by country and name
